description: This file declares the WindowManagerHandler class and its nested Notification class, which manage window events and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for initialization, termination, event handling, and rendering control, and references external interfaces and logging utilities.

classes.name: WindowManagerHandler
classes.description: Main class managing window events, notifications, and rendering within the plugin framework.

classes.name: WindowManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the notification interface for window manager events such as user inactivity, disconnection, and readiness.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources and terminates the window manager.

methods.name: renderReady
methods.description: Checks if the application instance is ready for rendering.

methods.name: enableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables display rendering for a specific application instance.
